profile.name: Vu Doan
profile.summary: Software engineer with 5 years on the frontend at a UK fintech, working in React, Svelte and TypeScript and building developer tooling that speeds up the team. Outside work, ships full-stack products with Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL.

experiences.summary: UK fintech building financial management software for the superyacht industry.
bullets: Build and maintain the production frontend in React, Svelte and TypeScript, including the shared Storybook component library.

Built FE Quick Dev, a VSCode extension (TypeScript, Node.js, Koa) on the Visual Studio Marketplace that serves local builds into the live app, cutting an 8–10 minute deploy-to-test cycle to a near-instant rebuild, now faster still after the move to Vite. Used daily by 3 frontend engineers, saving an estimated 4 hours a week, and by a backend engineer for live bug fixes.
Built Go and GraphQL services and a Python test-data generator for a group project: an A&E patient-wristband management system.

projects.title: InkPrint
projects.description: Turns hand-drawn glyphs into an installable font: compiles OTF in the browser with opentype.js, stores it in R2 and Postgres, and syncs it to a companion browser extension that applies it to every page. Live at inkprintweb.vercel.app.
